blockNote: Inventory screen overlay: full scene save / restore around the pause-menu inventory (191746-192584, Bank 02).

The inventory is a normal scene ($FF) with its own actors and thinkers that reuses the live WRAM. OpenInventoryScreen therefore saves the pools and state it will overwrite, builds scene $FF, runs UpdateFrameDialogue until the inventory_menu actor sets flag byte #00, restores everything and reloads the previous scene's graphics. Called through JSL from GlobalInputHandler (Select). Not saved: tile / map data (the scene script reloads it), VRAM (reloaded), sprite VRAM tiles for the player and ability effects (reloaded explicitly).
=== SAVE MAP (SaveGameState / RestoreGameState) ===
joypadCurrent, joypadHeld, joypadMaskStd ($0656-$065B) -> $7E:38AC-38B1 (joypadCurrent and joypadMaskStd are zeroed live)
activeActorCount ($0DBC) -> $0DBE (a word just outside every copied page)
DP $4E-$5D (8 words: actor free-list pointer $4E/$50, thinker free-list pointer $52/$54, actor list head / tail $56 / $58, thinker list head / tail $5A / $5C) -> $7E:389C
6 camera words $06BE-$06C9 (cameraTargetX, cameraDeltaX, cameraTargetY, cameraDeltaY, scrollOverrideH, forcedScrollOverride) -> $7E:3890; scrollOverrideV ($06CA) is NOT saved

MVN copies: $00:0E00 actor free-slot list -> $7E:3490; $7E:3000 thinker free-slot list -> $7E:3590; $00:1000-$1FFF actor slots -> $7F:E000; $7F:1000-$1FFF actor extended data -> $7F:F000; $00:0F00 thinker table (16 slots x $10) -> $7E:3690; $7F:0F00 thinker extended data -> $7E:3790; $7F:0A00 palette staging ($203 bytes) -> $7E:38B4 (restored separately by RestorePaletteBuffer)
The older text called $0E00 'hardware shadow registers', $7E:3000 the 'actor pool', $0F00 a 'variable / script page' and $7F:0F00 a 'WRAM scratch page'; the pool code shows the real roles above.
=== OPEN FLOW (OpenInventoryScreen) ===
1. EnableNmiOnly (NMITIMEN = $01: NMI OFF, joypad auto-read on), EnterForcedBlank (INIDISP $80), HDMAEN = 0. (The older text said 'EnableDisplay'; no such call exists.)
2. SaveGameState (above).

3. joypadMaskInv = $0F00 (the Up / Down / Left / Right bits). Push effectDeltaX (zeroed), displayModeFlags (set to $4000: every request bit clears; bit 14 has no reader, OQ-I034-1), eventFlags (zeroed; flag byte #00 is the loop's exit flag, so this also re-arms it), sceneCurrent (set to $FF, sceneTableIndex = $01FE). Event flag $FF (bit 7 of $0A1F, the scene-setup-complete latch) is cleared.

4. PPU: all window select / logic registers zero (windows off; WH0 = 0 and WH1 = $FF are inert without a W*SEL bit), BG3SC = $78 (tilemap at VRAM word $7800 = byte $F000), BG3 scroll zero, SceneScriptNoMusic builds scene $FF graphics, BG2SC = $0C, BG1SC = bg1ConfigMode = $04 (inventory_menu swaps BG1SC per tab), LoadScenePalettes, palette staging colour 2 = $5B1B (R27 G24 B22), UploadCgramPalette.

5. Source-pointer cache slots C ($0672) and D ($0675) are invalidated (zeroing addr-hi + bank forces the next lookup to miss, so the scene reload at close re-decompresses those BG tile sources). Camera targets / deltas, the four scroll accumulators, scrollOverrideH / V, forcedScrollOverride, $06CC and $00B2 are zeroed.
6. ClearVramBufferFull, InitActorPool, SpawnSceneActors, SpawnSceneThinkers, ClearActorRenderList.
7. RunActors_Normal x 2, SortActorsByDepth, $FFFF sentinel at the compose buffer, ComposeAllSprites, one UpdateFrameDialogue.
8. EnableNmiAndJoypad (NMITIMEN $81), VBlankWaitAndJoypad, INIDISP = $0F, EnableNmiOnly (NMI off again).

9. Main loop (code_02EE17): UpdateFrameDialogue (RunActors_CutsceneOnly, camera scroll, type-D thinkers, sprite compose, one VBlank wait with the NMI pulsed on, type-C thinkers), copy bg1ConfigMode to BG1SC, repeat while flag byte #00 equals #00 (BranchOnFlagByte).
=== CLOSE FLOW ===
10. BG3 vertical scroll zero, EnableNmiOnly, EnterForcedBlank, HDMAEN = 0.
11. RestoreGameState; then bg1ScrollH / mapScrollV / effectScrollH / effectScrollV are loaded from the restored cameraTargetX / cameraTargetY / cameraDeltaX / cameraDeltaY.
12. Pop sceneCurrent (sceneTableIndex recomputed), eventFlags, displayModeFlags, effectDeltaX.

13. SceneScriptNoMusic (previous scene's graphics), ApplyAllEventBlocks, PlaceOpenedChestTiles (rewrites the opened 2x2 pattern for chests whose flag is set; the older note said 'warp / barrier markers').
14. RestorePaletteBuffer, LoadScenePalettes, LoadPlayerGraphics, ReloadAbilityFX (tiles and palette selected by activeAbilityGfx $00EA).

15. ClearActorRenderList, ClearVramBufferFull, displayModeFlags |= $41 (bit 0 = full BG3 tilemap upload, bit 6 = sine-table rebuild trigger read by BuildSineLookupTable; the older text said 'dialogue'), LoadHudTilemap, then the player sprite cache ($09CC / $09CE) and cachedPrevHp / cachedPrevMaxHp are zeroed so the next frames treat them as changed, joypadMaskInv and the unnamed words $00F4 / $00F8 are zeroed.

16. RunBg3Script (BG3 console string), DrainActorQueue (resets the wait counter of every THINKER in the list at $5A, not an actor queue), ResetHdmaState, UpdateFrameRender, SetFlagByte #FF (the scene-setup-complete latch cleared in step 3), UpdateFrameRender, INIDISP = $0F, PLP, RTL.

OpenInventoryScreen: Open / run / close in one JSL (steps in the block note). PHP / PLP bracket the whole routine; A, X and Y are clobbered. The four words pushed in step 3 stay on the stack until step 12, so nothing between them may leave an unbalanced push.
code_02EE17: Main loop of the inventory scene: one UpdateFrameDialogue per pass, then bg1ConfigMode is copied to BG1SC (the inventory_menu actor changes it to flip between the item grid and the status view). Exits when flag byte #00 becomes nonzero; eventFlags was zeroed at open, so the loop starts armed.
ReloadAbilityFX: Re-uploads the ability effect tiles and palette after the inventory scene overwrote sprite VRAM. $00EA (activeAbilityGfx): 0 = nothing to do; 1 = misc_fx_1CC000 ($0480 bytes) to VRAM word $4400 and fx_palette_198070 (16 colours, staging colour index $A0 = OBJ palette row 10); 2 or more = misc_fx_1CC480 ($0600 bytes) to $4400 and fx_palette_198090 (7 colours from colour index $A9). The palette goes into the $7F0A00 staging buffer; the NMI upload sends it to CGRAM. The screen is still in forced blank, so the DMA is safe.
DrainActorQueue: Despite the name this walks the THINKER list: DP $5A is the thinker list head ($5C the tail; the actor list uses $56 / $58). For each thinker D is set to its slot, the wait counter at $08 is zeroed (0 = run on the next pass; a stored n skips n passes) and the next-link at $06 is followed until it is zero. It runs after RestoreGameState, so it hits the restored gameplay thinkers, not leftovers of the inventory scene. D and P are saved around it. Name proposal: R-I034-1.
SaveGameState: Copies the state listed in the block note's SAVE MAP into the backup areas and zeroes joypadCurrent / joypadMaskStd so no gameplay input leaks into the inventory scene. DBR is saved with PHB because every MVN leaves the destination bank in DBR. Each MVN leaves X / Y just past its block, which is why some copies reload only one of the two registers (save: X only on the second, fourth and sixth copy; restore: Y only on the second and fourth).
RestoreGameState: Reverse of SaveGameState for everything except the palette staging buffer. DP $4E-$5D comes back before the pages it points into; both are restored before anything runs. scrollOverrideV, $06CC and $00B2 are not restored because they were never saved (OQ-I034-4).
RestorePaletteBuffer: Copies $203 bytes from $7E:38B4 back to the $7F:0A00 palette staging buffer. Called after the scene graphics are reloaded so LoadScenePalettes and the ability palette see the saved colours.

blockNote: Static 5-gem pickup actor: shows spriteset_enemies frame #06 and carries item ID $85 in chatPtr. No scene actor list or COP spawn in extracted/ refers to it by name (OQ-I034-3).

Header bytes: animation state 0 and flags word $0020 (ORed with $4000 by InitActorFromSceneData, so $4020). Bit $0020 marks the actor friendly: when the player overlaps it ApplyInteractionDamage routes to InteractionDamage_NPCChat, which calls GiveItemToPlayer(chatPtr). Item $85 is '+5 gems' (cap 999, SFX #22); DarkGemDropAnimVariantA spawns the same $85 with the same frame #06, so this is the stationary version of that gem. The older header called it a static NPC / decoration and the chatPtr a dialog bank pointer; neither is supported (the interaction path is UNVERIFIED-RUNTIME).

Pass structure: init stores chatPtr and the metasprite, SetEntryHere marks the re-entry address, then StageSpriteFrame #06 and AnimOnce run on every pass. No SetSpritePalette is issued here, unlike the gem spawners, which use palette #00.

blockNote: One-shot thinker (filter word $0800) that sets the PPU fixed colour (COLDATA $2132) to R = 11, G = 4, B = 2 with three writes, then kills itself.

COLDATA: bit $20 selects red, $40 green, $80 blue, the low five bits are the intensity; a write only changes the channels whose bits are set. $2B sets red to 11, $44 sets green to 4, $82 sets blue to 2. The fixed colour is red-dominant: if CGADSUB adds it the cast is orange-red, if it subtracts it the screen loses mostly red and looks green-cyan. This thinker does not touch CGWSEL / CGADSUB (the scene's display preset does), so the 'green' in the name and in the older header is only right for a subtract preset (OQ-I034-2). Rename proposal: R-I034-2.

Spawned only by scene thinker list $0CE80C for scene $30 (slot $00 in tables/scene_thinkers.asm; scene $01 enters the same list four bytes later and skips it). The older 'South Cape scene group' claim is not backed by the table (scene names are not decoded), and 'before the warm palette cycler takes over' is unverified: the same list also spawns two ambient_palette_cycler thinkers and a flag_gated_palette_warm thinker, and UploadCgramPalette rewrites COLDATA from backdropColors ($7F0C00-02) every NMI (bytes without channel bits change nothing, scene_lifecycle zeroes them at setup).
